import platform
import sys

def clear_caches():
    platform._platform_cache.clear()
    platform._sys_version_cache.clear()
    platform._uname_cache = None
    platform._os_release_cache = None

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.save_version = sys.version
    self.save_git = sys._git
    self.save_platform = sys.platform
    clear_caches()
    assert platform._platform_cache == {}, ('assertDictEqual', platform._platform_cache, {})
    assert platform._sys_version_cache == {}, ('assertDictEqual', platform._sys_version_cache, {})
    assert platform._uname_cache is None, ('assertIsNone', platform._uname_cache)
    assert platform._os_release_cache is None, ('assertIsNone', platform._os_release_cache)
    platform.platform()
    platform.python_implementation()
    platform.uname()
    assert platform._platform_cache != {}, ('assertNotEqual', platform._platform_cache, {})
    assert platform._sys_version_cache != {}, ('assertNotEqual', platform._sys_version_cache, {})
    assert platform._uname_cache is not None, ('assertIsNotNone', platform._uname_cache)
    try:
        platform.freedesktop_os_release()
    except OSError:
        assert platform._os_release_cache is None, ('assertIsNone', platform._os_release_cache)
    else:
        assert platform._os_release_cache is not None, ('assertIsNotNone', platform._os_release_cache)
    platform.invalidate_caches()
    assert platform._platform_cache == {}, ('assertDictEqual', platform._platform_cache, {})
    assert platform._sys_version_cache == {}, ('assertDictEqual', platform._sys_version_cache, {})
    assert platform._uname_cache is None, ('assertIsNone', platform._uname_cache)
    assert platform._os_release_cache is None, ('assertIsNone', platform._os_release_cache)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import platform
import sys

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.save_version = sys.version
    self.save_git = sys._git
    self.save_platform = sys.platform
    res = platform.android_ver()
    assert isinstance(res, tuple), ('assertIsInstance', res, tuple)
    assert res == (res.release, res.api_level, res.manufacturer, res.model, res.device, res.is_emulator), ('assertEqual', res, (res.release, res.api_level, res.manufacturer, res.model, res.device, res.is_emulator))
    if sys.platform == 'android':
        for name in ['release', 'manufacturer', 'model', 'device']:
            value = getattr(res, name)
            assert isinstance(value, str), ('assertIsInstance', value, str)
            assert value != '', ('assertNotEqual', value, '')
        assert isinstance(res.api_level, int), ('assertIsInstance', res.api_level, int)
        assert res.api_level >= sys.getandroidapilevel(), ('assertGreaterEqual', res.api_level, sys.getandroidapilevel())
        assert isinstance(res.is_emulator, bool), ('assertIsInstance', res.is_emulator, bool)
    else:
        assert res.release == '', ('assertEqual', res.release, '')
        assert res.api_level == 0, ('assertEqual', res.api_level, 0)
        assert res.manufacturer == '', ('assertEqual', res.manufacturer, '')
        assert res.model == '', ('assertEqual', res.model, '')
        assert res.device == '', ('assertEqual', res.device, '')
        assert res.is_emulator == False, ('assertEqual', res.is_emulator, False)
        res = platform.android_ver('alpha', 1, 'bravo', 'charlie', 'delta', True)
        assert res.release == 'alpha', ('assertEqual', res.release, 'alpha')
        assert res.api_level == 1, ('assertEqual', res.api_level, 1)
        assert res.manufacturer == 'bravo', ('assertEqual', res.manufacturer, 'bravo')
        assert res.model == 'charlie', ('assertEqual', res.model, 'charlie')
        assert res.device == 'delta', ('assertEqual', res.device, 'delta')
        assert res.is_emulator == True, ('assertEqual', res.is_emulator, True)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import platform
import sys
FEDORA_OS_RELEASE = 'NAME=Fedora
VERSION="32 (Thirty Two)"
ID=fedora
VERSION_ID=32
VERSION_CODENAME=""
PLATFORM_ID="platform:f32"
PRETTY_NAME="Fedora 32 (Thirty Two)"
ANSI_COLOR="0;34"
LOGO=fedora-logo-icon
CPE_NAME="cpe:/o:fedoraproject:fedora:32"
HOME_URL="https://fedoraproject.org/"
DOCUMENTATION_URL="https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/fedora/f32/system-administrators-guide/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://fedoraproject.org/wiki/Communicating_and_getting_help"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugzilla.redhat.com/"
REDHAT_BUGZILLA_PRODUCT="Fedora"
REDHAT_BUGZILLA_PRODUCT_VERSION=32
REDHAT_SUPPORT_PRODUCT="Fedora"
REDHAT_SUPPORT_PRODUCT_VERSION=32
PRIVACY_POLICY_URL="https://fedoraproject.org/wiki/Legal:PrivacyPolicy"
'
UBUNTU_OS_RELEASE = 'NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION="20.04.1 LTS (Focal Fossa)"
ID=ubuntu
ID_LIKE=debian
PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 20.04.1 LTS"
VERSION_ID="20.04"
HOME_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://help.ubuntu.com/"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/"
PRIVACY_POLICY_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/legal/terms-and-policies/privacy-policy"
VERSION_CODENAME=focal
UBUNTU_CODENAME=focal
'
TEST_OS_RELEASE = '
# test data
ID_LIKE="egg spam viking"
EMPTY=
# comments and empty lines are ignored

SINGLE_QUOTE='single'
EMPTY_SINGLE=''
DOUBLE_QUOTE="double"
EMPTY_DOUBLE=""
QUOTES="double\'s"
SPECIALS="\$\`\\\'\""
# invalid lines
=invalid
=
INVALID
IN-VALID=value
IN VALID=value
'

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.save_version = sys.version
    self.save_git = sys._git
    self.save_platform = sys.platform
    info = platform._parse_os_release(FEDORA_OS_RELEASE.splitlines())
    assert info['NAME'] == 'Fedora', ('assertEqual', info['NAME'], 'Fedora')
    assert info['ID'] == 'fedora', ('assertEqual', info['ID'], 'fedora')
    assert 'ID_LIKE' not in info, ('assertNotIn', 'ID_LIKE', info)
    assert info['VERSION_CODENAME'] == '', ('assertEqual', info['VERSION_CODENAME'], '')
    info = platform._parse_os_release(UBUNTU_OS_RELEASE.splitlines())
    assert info['NAME'] == 'Ubuntu', ('assertEqual', info['NAME'], 'Ubuntu')
    assert info['ID'] == 'ubuntu', ('assertEqual', info['ID'], 'ubuntu')
    assert info['ID_LIKE'] == 'debian', ('assertEqual', info['ID_LIKE'], 'debian')
    assert info['VERSION_CODENAME'] == 'focal', ('assertEqual', info['VERSION_CODENAME'], 'focal')
    info = platform._parse_os_release(TEST_OS_RELEASE.splitlines())
    expected = {'ID': 'linux', 'NAME': 'Linux', 'PRETTY_NAME': 'Linux', 'ID_LIKE': 'egg spam viking', 'EMPTY': '', 'DOUBLE_QUOTE': 'double', 'EMPTY_DOUBLE': '', 'SINGLE_QUOTE': 'single', 'EMPTY_SINGLE': '', 'QUOTES': "double's", 'SPECIALS': '$`\'"'}
    assert info == expected, ('assertEqual', info, expected)
    assert len(info['SPECIALS']) == 5, ('assertEqual', len(info['SPECIALS']), 5)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
